name: Paymentfor Gateway for WooCommerce
author: paymentfor

sections.description:
Paymentfor Gateway for WooCommerce is a free plugin that integrates Payment for, Inc. payment services with WooCommerce, enabling secure acceptance of multiple payment methods. To use this plugin, you must have an active merchant account with Payment for, Inc. The plugin operates in compliance with PCI DSS standards and supports EMV 3-D Secure 2.0 authentication for enhanced security.
Supported payment methods include credit card payments (non-pass-through token-based or link-based), convenience store online payments, and PayPay mobile wallet payments. Recurring subscription payments are supported through the WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or newer.
  • PHP 7.4 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or newer.
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions tested up to 8.2.1 (for subscription payments).
  • SSL certificate required (SHA2 algorithm, TLS 1.2 only).
  • Merchant account with Payment for, Inc.

Build Process

This plugin includes minified JavaScript files in the build/ directory for the block-based checkout functionality. These files are generated using @wordpress/scripts and webpack.

The source files for the block checkout are developed using React and modern JavaScript, then compiled into the production-ready files you see in the build/ directory.

Build dependencies:
– Node.js and npm
– @wordpress/scripts package

If you need to rebuild the JavaScript files from source, you would need to set up a Node.js development environment with @wordpress/scripts. However, for normal plugin use, this is not necessary as the compiled files are included.

Setup

Before using this plugin, you must have an active merchant account with Payment for, Inc. Contact Payment for, Inc. at https://www.paymentfor.com/ to apply.
Once approved, you will receive an IP Code and IP Password required for configuration.
To configure each payment method, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and click Manage for the desired payment method. Enter your credentials and configure the settings as needed. Save your changes.
For convenience store and PayPay payments, you must register payment notification URLs with Payment for, Inc. to receive payment confirmations. The required URLs are displayed in the payment settings.

Payment Processing

All payment operations (sales confirmation, cancellation, refund) must be performed through the WooCommerce order management interface, not through the Payment for, Inc. merchant dashboard. Performing operations outside of WooCommerce may cause synchronization failures.
Do not delete order records before completing payment adjustments, as this will prevent WooCommerce from processing payment modifications. If an order is deleted, contact Payment for, Inc. merchant support for transaction adjustments.

Testing

Verify all payment settings are configured correctly before testing. Obtain test card numbers from the Payment for, Inc. merchant dashboard. Complete test purchases using the test cards and verify transactions appear in the Payment for, Inc. merchant dashboard. Test payment operations including sales confirmation and cancellation. If testing with real cards, always cancel the test transaction afterward.

Important Notes

SSL certificate installation is mandatory. Signature algorithm must be SHA2 and communication protocol must be TLS 1.2 only (TLS 1.3 not supported). Contact your hosting provider for SSL configuration verification.
This plugin complies with PCI DSS standards. Credit card information is never stored on your server. It is securely transmitted and stored only in Payment for, Inc. systems.
For convenience store and PayPay payments, payment completion notifications are only received if notification URLs are properly registered with Payment for, Inc.

External Services

This plugin connects to Payment for, Inc.’s payment gateway services to process payments. This connection is required for the plugin to function.

Service Provider: Payment for, Inc.
Website: https://www.paymentfor.com/

What data is sent:
– Transaction information (order ID, transaction code, amount, product names)
– Customer information (name, address, email, phone number)
– Payment information (credit card details are transmitted directly to Payment for’s secure servers and never stored on your site)

When data is sent:
– When a customer completes checkout using Payment for payment methods
– When processing payment confirmations, cancellations, or refunds
– When checking payment status or user ID information

API Endpoints Used:
This plugin connects to Payment for, Inc.’s secure payment processing servers. Specific endpoint details are provided in the technical documentation.

Terms and Privacy:
– Privacy Policy: https://www.paymentfor.com/etc/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://www.paymentfor.com/etc/agreement

Please refer to Payment for, Inc.’s privacy policy and terms of service for details on how they handle your data.

For more information about Payment for, Inc.’s services and data handling practices, please visit their website or contact their support team.

Support

For technical support, contact Welcart Inc. at https://www.welcart.com/
For merchant account questions, contact Payment for, Inc. at https://www.paymentfor.com/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option. Log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New, search for “Paymentfor Gateway for WooCommerce”, and click Install Now. After installation, click Activate Plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to WordPress Plugins > Add New
  3. Click Upload Plugin
  4. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Go to Installed Plugins and click Activate
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support subscription payments?

Yes, through the WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin (paid add-on).

Convenience store payments are not marked as paid. What should I do?

Verify you have registered the “Payment Completion Notification URL” with Payment for, Inc. and that the registered URL is correct and accessible. Contact Payment for, Inc. support to confirm registration.

Payment errors occur unexpectedly. What should I check?

  1. Verify all payment settings are correct
  2. Confirm SSL certificate is valid (SHA2, TLS 1.2 only)
  3. Check for Basic authentication or IP restrictions
  4. Verify no JavaScript errors in browser console
  5. Temporarily disable other plugins and test again

What currencies are supported?

Only Japanese Yen (JPY). This plugin is available for Japan-based merchants only.
